//: Hold out in a house on the lane through one night (13 §11, a survival game in small). The game begins at ten at night in front of a house; `start.do` brings three strangers onto the lane, each a person who thinks with the `guard` mind (09 §3.1) and perceives with its senses, given when the mind's state is first made (decision D-901), puts a knife in each one's hand, tags them `hostile` and has each hold the character hostile, and makes the house each one's beat, so that they walk the lane before its door and come for the character once they see it there; and the character, who was told they mean harm, holds each of them hostile in turn (so walking into one strikes, and a long wait is broken off when one comes into sight); it marks the nearest door as the refuge and lights a lamp beside it, the one light on a dark lane, which a player may leave burning to see them come or put out to hide; and it sets a timer for dawn, eight hours on, that completes the objective of holding out. The player chooses who they are among the playable templates, ready-made (13 §4.2), or is an ordinary person. Getting inside comes first. The game ends when dawn comes or when the character dies, and it has one save, gone when it ends.
name: Last stand
doc: A house on the lane at night, and strangers on the road. Hold out until dawn.
intro: It is ten at night. Three strangers are on the lane and they mean you harm. Get into the house and hold out until dawn.
